findings.title: All app imports start when the store is initialized
findings.body: Each `import()` is evaluated while this object is constructed, so importing the store starts loading every app module, not just the app selected later. This defeats per-app lazy loading and makes unrelated app dependencies load and initialize for every consumer of the store.

findings.title: Reschedule does not wait for asynchronous integration cleanup
findings.body: `forEach` discards the promises returned by its async callbacks. The function can therefore send the reschedule email and return success before `getCalendar` and the calendar/video deletion finish. Rejections from the callback also bypass the surrounding `try/catch`, so an import or cleanup failure can leave the old integration event in place while the reschedule is reported as successful.

findings.title: Reschedule does not wait for asynchronous integration cleanup
findings.body: `forEach` discards the promises returned by its async callbacks. The function can therefore send the reschedule email and return success before `getCalendar` and the calendar/video deletion finish. Rejections from the callback also bypass the surrounding `try/catch`, so an import or cleanup failure can leave the old integration event in place while the reschedule is reported as successful.

findings.title: The reschedule mutation does not wait for integration cleanup
findings.body: `forEach` discards the promises returned by its async callbacks, so the mutation does not wait for `getCalendar` or the subsequent calendar/video deletion. It can continue to send the reschedule email and finish while the import or deletion is still pending; callback failures are unhandled and the old integration event can remain after the booking is canceled.
